# Voice Cloning Web Application - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
Ultra-advanced voice cloning web application with React.js frontend and Node.js/Express backend.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React.js with TypeScript, Material-UI, Redux Toolkit
- Backend: Node.js with Express.js and TypeScript
- Database: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- AI/ML: TensorFlow.js, Web Audio API, WebRTC
- Real-time: Socket.io for WebSocket connections
- Security: JWT authentication, AES-256 encryption
- Deployment: Docker containers, cloud-ready

## Key Features
- High-fidelity voice recording and processing
- AI-powered voice analysis and cloning
- Real-time speech-to-speech conversion
- Multi-language support and translation
- Emotion and style transfer
- Enterprise-grade security and compliance

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Implement comprehensive error handling
- Follow security best practices
- Optimize for performance and scalability
- Include comprehensive testing
- Document all APIs and components
